title: Guided ultrasound
source: Team's clinical lead, build pack v3.3. Placeholder.
imageNote: Live image would show here. No image is captured or kept in this demo.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.instruction: Get the ultrasound probe and gel ready, as your kit card shows.

steps.title: Left side
steps.instruction: Probe on the left side, just below the ribs. Marker towards the head.
steps.note: Compare with the right side in step 3.

steps.title: Right side
steps.instruction: Probe on the right side, just below the ribs. Marker towards the head.
steps.lookFor: Look for: the same view as step 2, to compare the two sides.

steps.title: Save
steps.instruction: Save. The steps you completed go into the case for your crew medic and Earth.
